notes: SAR2SAR steps B and C (Dalsasso et al. 2021): the single-step model fine-tuned on pairs of survey years, input from year a, target year b's EA DTM compensated for change: label_b - x_hat_b + x_hat_a (x_hat from step A for B, from step B for C: --set data.compensation=xhat_b). Noise2Noise's L1 loss (Lehtinen et al. 2018) in place of GrounDiff's L1 + L2. Learning rate 1/100 of step A's initial one, as in SAR2SAR; run_n2n.sh sets the length (a third of step A each, as SAR2SAR's 10 vs 30 epochs).
